## Plan

_Written by `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43304231986)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Get fuzz (3/4) and fuzz (4/4) of the daily super run green again. Both fail on the fuzz monitor's new I16 check, added by #3746. I ran the shards' own commands on a release build of `3d347d9`. Three seeds fail, each through a different engine leak:

- **Duos seed 1628 (fuzz 4/4):** C+ #31 Fusion Lab fuses S #16 Rod of Ages into C+ #65 Two Grapes, making a fused **Spell**. That Spell keeps Rod's end-of-turn hook ("gain random keywords"). `flag_return_to_hand_at_end_of_turn` flags any Spell with an `endOfTurn` hook for the end-of-turn return. So Rod's text runs from the graveyard and grants Poisonous to the card lying there.
- **Plain seed 6091 (fuzz 3/4):** a fused Unit's Cry exiles the card (C #44 Back from the GY's "Exile this"). A later #93 Combo-Index Cry part then writes `counters.grade` on the exiled card.
- **Plain seed 6140 (fuzz 3/4):** a fused Field Trap discards its chosen hand card. A later C+ #41 KY's Constant part then sets that card's cost, writing `costMod` on a graveyard card (against R766).

Every other wave of shards 3 and 4 passes. Done means:
- each leak is fixed in the engine and has its own ruling and a test named after it;
- the three seeds pass;
- shards 3 and 4 replay clean.

The fixes were prototyped outside the repo and turned all three seeds green.

## Steps

1. **`crates/engine/src/effects/targets.rs`**: add this function directly above `pub fn stands_since_script_began`. It calls the private `left_field_since` in the same file; `ZoneName` is already imported.
   ```rust
   /// R3800000: whether the running card stood off the field when the running script began and has not left
   /// the field since: a fused Spell's end-of-turn return run from its graveyard (R153, R155), and wherever
   /// that return moved it on to, never a card an earlier effect of the same run took off the field (R174).
   pub fn ran_off_the_field(ctx: &EffectContext<'_>) -> bool {
       let Some(this) = ctx.live_self() else {
           return false;
       };
       this.zone.z() != ZoneName::Field && !left_field_since(ctx, &this.id)
   }
   ```
   Why this works: `make_context` sets `exits_from` to the exit mark when the run starts. So a Unit+Unit fusion whose first end-of-turn part kills it still runs its second part, as it does today.

2. **`crates/engine/src/subsystems/fuse.rs`**: add these directly above `fn fused_script`. `CardType`, `IndexSet`, `Hook` and `hook` are already imported.
   ```rust
   /// R3800000: a non-Spell ingredient's end-of-turn text (a Unit's, a Field Spell's, a Trap's) runs where that
   /// text runs, on the field or in the backrow. Run off the field (a fused Spell's graveyard return, R153,
   /// R155, and wherever that return moved it on to), it makes no effect.
   fn field_end_of_turn(text: Hook) -> Hook {
       hook(move |ctx| {
           if crate::effects::targets::ran_off_the_field(ctx) {
               return Vec::new();
           }
           text(ctx)
       })
   }

   /// R3800000: whether a Spell's own text among `def_id`'s, on `radiant`'s form, has an end-of-turn hook,
   /// the end-of-turn return R155 flags: an unfused Spell's own; a fused Spell's when one of its Spell
   /// ingredients' does, each on the form it went in on (R469), a fused ingredient's read the same way.
   pub fn spell_text_ends_turn(state: &GameState, def_id: &str, radiant: bool) -> bool {
       spell_text_ends_turn_in(state, def_id, radiant, &mut IndexSet::new())
   }

   fn spell_text_ends_turn_in(state: &GameState, def_id: &str, radiant: bool, seen: &mut IndexSet<String>) -> bool {
       if crate::faces::card_type_of_face(state, def_id, radiant) != CardType::Spell {
           return false;
       }
       let Some(specs) = fused_specs(state, def_id) else {
           return crate::scripts::face_ref(state, def_id, radiant).end_of_turn.is_some();
       };
       if !seen.insert(def_id.to_string()) {
           return false;
       }
       specs
           .iter()
           .any(|spec| spell_text_ends_turn_in(state, &spec.def_id, radiant || spec.radiant == Some(true), seen))
   }
   ```
   Then, in `fused_script`, replace the `records` builder (`.map(|(index, face)| script_record(&face.script, &face.def_id, face.radiant, index))`) with:
   ```rust
   .map(|(index, face)| {
       let mut record = script_record(&face.script, &face.def_id, face.radiant, index);
       // R3800000: a non-Spell ingredient's end-of-turn text is a field text.
       if crate::faces::card_type_of_face(state, &face.def_id, face.radiant) != CardType::Spell {
           record.end_of_turn = record.end_of_turn.map(field_end_of_turn);

   })
   ```

- [ ] `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools`. The target dir may be `$CARGO_TARGET_DIR`; find the binary with `cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps`. Then these three each report 0 failed:

  - `jackioh fuzz --from 6091 --seeds 1`
  - `jackioh fuzz --from 6140 --seeds 1`
- [ ] Shard 4's steps exactly as super.yml runs them, all exit 0: `fuzz --from 7501 --seeds 2500`, the same with `--handicap`, and `fuzz --duos --from 1501 --seeds 500`.
- [ ] Shard 3's: `fuzz --from 5001 --seeds 2500`, the same with `--handicap`, and `fuzz --duos --from 1001 --seeds 500`.
  - On 4 cores each 2,500-seed wave takes about 8–12 minutes, and each Duos wave about 5.
  - If time allows, also run shards 1–2 (`--from 1`/`2501`, Duos `--from 1`/`501`), since the fix can change a game's path.
  - A new failing seed is a new root cause: trace it the same way and fix it in this branch. Never weaken I16.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` (CI's gate) passes.
- [ ] Every harness check passes: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings (`spec check`), clippy, cargo tests (including the clean `apps/web/src/wire` diff), web tests.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes, or what it names is handled (Risks).
- [ ] The report says which job each fix makes pass, with the commands above and their output: fuzz (4/4) needs Duos seed 1628, fuzz (3/4) needs plain seeds 6091 and 6140.

## Risks

- **Replays and determinism.** All three changes only bite where I16 would fire, or where a fused Spell runs end-of-turn text from its graveyard, so other games fold as before. The cargo tests' golden/hotseat fold and the fuzz replay check prove it. No new rng draw is added. In `set_number` the `ref_for` draw still happens before the guard, so the rng cursor is unchanged.
- **The guard's reach.** `field_end_of_turn` wraps non-Spell ingredients in every fused script. It skips only when the run began off the field, which for end-of-turn happens only in a flagged graveyard Spell's run (R153). Do not replace `ran_off_the_field` with a plain "is in a graveyard" check: that would cut a Unit+Unit fusion's second end-of-turn part after the first kills it, against R3693000's "a begun firing keeps running".
- **`rust (classify)` on the PR.** #3746's similar engine fix needed no fragment. If CI's classify names a family that plays differently, add `cargo jackioh patches "Fuzz fixes: fused Spell end-of-turn, Combo-Index grade, KY's Constant cost off the field" --plays <the ids it names>`. Do not add one up front: R1370000 fails a refuted claim.
- **Same-class writers left alone.** These write `costMod`/`costOverride` and could hit the same problem on a card moved to a graveyard mid-resolution:
  - a Degrade/Upgrade cost step (`tune.rs` `cost_row` excludes only the field);
  - `effects/cost.rs`, `give.rs`;
  - the plague counter writers in `plague.rs`.

  No seed found them. Changing `cost_row` would move rng draws in ordinary games, so they are out of scope here.
- **Fuzz corpus.** No corpus record is added. `--regress` replays from a plain start, so seed 6140 (Glitch boards) would not reproduce, and Duos has no corpus. The named tests pin each path instead.

## Open questions

- None block the build. One for a person: do the same-class price and counter writers in Risks deserve a follow-up issue now, or should they wait until a daily seed hits one? I left them out to keep this fix to the three failing seeds.
